description: SkipHow continuity: after compaction or resume, point the session at the owner request, live Git and GitHub state, and the latest handoff checkpoint.

hooks.command: sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "SkipHow: this session was compacted or resumed. Re-read the owner request, then live Git and GitHub state, before acting. If .skiphow/handoff.md exists, its latest checkpoint follows."; if [ -f .skiphow/handoff.md ]; then tail -n 40 .skiphow/handoff.md; fi; exit 0'
